I am an old woman, 83 years now, and I have been farming this land my whole life. My rice plot is small, less than one hectare, but rice needs care and the soil gets tired after many seasons. I will put a little fertilizer — maybe one bag of urea or CAN if the price is not too high this year — and also spread the manure we collect from the animals around the homestead. At my age, I cannot do all the work myself, so my children and grandchildren help me, and during transplanting and harvest I must pay a few neighbors to come work.

I will plant the seed I saved from last season, as my mother and grandmother did. I do not trust the new seeds from town, and they cost too much for me. I do not spray chemicals on rice, and this plot depends on the rains — I have no way to bring water.
